reviews.title: Money stolen
reviews.text: This platform offered me a palm read for 1$. I go through the process of doing this and seems like they force you to create an account, sign-up, install their app, agree on a 7-day trial and store your payment info for a 1$ palm read. Then after finishing palm read (which I don't even want to mention how terrible it was, same template without any difference from others) I think I am done and uninstall the app. Everything good so far until after this period expires they STEAL your 40$ without any consent! Why would you do that? Scammers, liars and thiefs in simple words.

reviews.title: ⚠️ Charged after cancellation – Be careful
reviews.text:
I canceled my subscription, but I was still charged again afterward. This is not acceptable and raises serious concerns about their billing practices.

I expected the subscription to stop immediately after cancellation, but that didn’t happen. I recommend checking your subscriptions carefully if you use this app.
reviews.reply:
Greetings there,

Thank you for taking the time to share your experience and for bringing this to our attention! ✨ We’re truly sorry to hear about the frustration this situation caused - we completely understand how concerning it can feel when a charge appears after you expected a subscription to end.

We’d like to note that once a subscription is successfully canceled, no further charges should occur. Our team would be glad to take a closer look at what may have happened in your case and help clarify everything for you.

For further assistance, contact us at support-appstore@asknebula.com - we’ll be more than happy to review your request and support you.

Holding space for your journey,
Nebula Team
